t: This is a place connected with P&O, the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company, a British shipping and logistics firm dating back to the early nineteenth century. It was co-founded by Arthur Anderson, a Scottish businessman and Whig politician. The company was sold to DP World in March 2006 for three point nine billion pounds. DP World still runs several P&O branded businesses, including P&O Ferries, and also looks after P&O Heritage, the official historic archive and collection of the company.
